execution_rule: ONLY a task with authorized=true AND status=AUTHORIZED may be executed automatically.

tasks.title: Capture game-day practice-squad elevation records (week 5 retrospectively, week 6 onward prelock)
tasks.objective: Owner OD-002 (2026-10-14): missing elevation records are not proof of ineligibility. With none captured, every practice-squad player is ELIGIBILITY_UNRESOLVED; on W5 Classic that is 92 players across 16 clubs (nfl/research/contract45/AUDIT_W5_ELIGIBILITY_COVERAGE.md), and every certified release refuses (ELIGIBILITY_UNRESOLVED_MATERIAL). Needed per slate: the clubs' official game-day practice-squad elevations (standard elevations, announced the day before a game), as a JSON list of player names per game, with retrieved_at and source URL, captured BEFORE the release cutoff. Engineering has no network.
acceptance_tests: a JSON list per slate (nfl/dfs/salaries/<slate dir>/elevations/ELEVATIONS_<slate>.json), names as published, with retrieved_at and a source per entry
an empty list only when the source says no club elevated anyone (an empty list is evidence; a missing file is not)

for week 5: the elevations actually announced for the 2026-10-11 games, captured from an archived source with its retrieval time recorded (a postgame capture is research evidence only, never a prelock input)
